tools.name: get_horoscope
tools.description: The daily horoscope of one sign: theme, the reading, what the day's sky means for the sign, and ratings (-2 to +2). In German, English or Spanish.

tools.name: get_day
tools.description: A whole day: the Moon's sign, the day's sky and all twelve signs (German days also link the podcast episode).

tools.name: get_moon_phases
tools.description: Every new and full moon in a date range (default: the next 90 days) with the UTC time, the zodiac sign, eclipses and the full moon's traditional name (Harvest Moon, Hunter's Moon …). Calculated.

tools.name: get_panchang
tools.description: Tithi, nakshatra, yoga and karana for a date (Indian Standard Time), each with its start and end. Lahiri ayanamsa, calculated. Sunrise, Rahu Kaal and the tithi at sunrise depend on the place: skyandsigns.com/panchang/.

tools.name: get_solar_terms
tools.description: The 24 solar terms (jieqi) of a year with the exact moment (UTC; the date in China is Beijing time), hanzi, pinyin and names. Calculated.

tools.name: get_maya_day
tools.description: The day in the 260-day Maya calendar for a date: number and nawal (K'iche' and Yucatec name, meaning), and the Long Count. GMT correlation 584283, the count Guatemalan daykeepers keep. The meaning of a day is given by an ajq'ij.

tools.name: get_islamic_dates
tools.description: The expected beginning of Ramadan, Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha 1448 (2027) and 1449 (2028) by the Umm al-Qura calendar, Diyanet and FCNA/ISNA, with the sighting outlook. Each community decides; dates may differ by a day.

tools.name: list_days
tools.description: Every day with a published horoscope, newest last.
